author: mark
text:
Phase 7: make install harness root scaffold

Make install lays down ~/.lernie/{adapters,workflows,tools,skills,
agents,conversations} on first run, drops the bundled anthropic
adapter into <harness-root>/adapters/, copies template/ to
agents/default/, and writes a default global providers.yaml.
Re-runs are idempotent — directories use mkdir -p; config files
are guarded with test -e so rotated keys and hand edits survive.

The runtime adapter resolver (src/prompt/adapter.rs) gains the
§4.4 lookup hop: <harness-root>/adapters/lernie-provider-<name>
first, then PATH. Without this the new install location would be
decorative.

lernie binary now reports --version (clap version derive) so the
post-install verify step (lernie --version + lernie new tmp + cleanup)
exercises both surfaces. README quickstart and adapter-discovery
sections rewritten for the new shape.
